nodes.name: Cooling Loop Failover
nodes.text: Switch from failed coolant loop A to redundant loop B. Verify flow rate and outlet temperature stabilize within 5 minutes. Monitor accumulator level.

nodes.name: O2 Regulator Fault Response
nodes.text: If O2 regulator is stuck, manually adjust supplemental O2 flow. Monitor ppO2 continuously. Target 21.3 kPa. Alert if ppO2 drops below 19.5 kPa.
